I've set up the "Pod end of day" post for weekdays at 17:30 Chicago time (22:30 UTC). It will summarise the day's new #strategic-pod messages and post them in that channel.

Two things to know:
- The scheduler isn't running yet. The gateway has to be started (`hermes gateway start`) before the job will fire.
- I posted a reply in #strategic-pod thread to you confirming the setup. Its wording about the first run timing is a bit muddled, so ignore that part; the schedule itself is as above.
